answer: Since the throttle counters live in the umber ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 72 keys as a result pays for 72 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the prism quota and the lagoon admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
